item.title: fix(ui): model Inbox alert dismissibility (#129495)
item.summary: fix(ui): model Inbox alert dismissibility (#129495) Make every Inbox producer declare a dismissal fact or null so stable limited-access guidance can retire without hiding active requests, approvals, or forced updates. Derive counts and rendering from one typed entry list and persist snoozes per browser and Gateway.
